verdict.rationale: Casium's visa guides restate USCIS rules, such as the EB-1A criteria requirement and I-140 self-petitioning. However, none of the evidence shows those claims grounded in USCIS processing data, FOIA statistics, or linked citations to official policy. Paraphrasing government rules without sourcing is adjacent to the story, not delivery of it.

support.subject: As a developer evaluating providers, the provider grounds its public claims in government data — USCIS processing data, FOIA statistics, or official policy citations with links
